title: LandStackAIToolsSpecification
description: Standardized tool calling specification for Member 3's LLM Agent

tools.name: get_unified_parcel_profile
tools.description: Fetch the complete 360-degree profile for a land parcel by its ULPIN including GIS boundaries, RoR ownership, tax records, encumbrances, court cases, zoning, and risk anomalies.

ulpin.description: The Unique Land Parcel Identification Number (e.g. 'UL001', 'UL002')

tools.name: get_parcels_in_area
tools.description: Retrieve and aggregate all parcel records within a specified list of ULPINs or GIS region.

tools.name: get_court_cases
tools.description: Check if a parcel has active court disputes, injunctions, or stay orders.

tools.name: get_encumbrance_status
tools.description: Check bank mortgage loans and financial liens for a parcel.
